description: Official final answer keys (exam bodies' own PDFs only, never coaching re-typed keys). `pxw keys sync` fetches each entry and links answers to our questions by NTA question/option ids. Prefer the exam body's own URL; an Internet Archive copy (web.archive.org/web/<ts>id_/<official url>) only when the official file is gone. Owner decision 2026-11-20: archive copies and mirrors that re-host the original PDF unchanged are allowed.
